entities.name: Nicolas Maréchal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolas Maréchal is a French professional volleyball player with Polish citizenship, a former member of the France national team. The 2015 European Champion, and the 2015 World League winner. At the professional club level, he plays for Modena Volley.
